copy.headline: Colleyville City Council considering pet resort permit
copy.caption: A proposed All American Pet Resorts on Colleyville Boulevard dominated the Nov. 4 Colleyville City Council meeting, drawing hours of debate from residents, competing business owners, attorneys and council members. Central to the evening was a special use permit request by All American Pet Resorts to allow dog daycare, boarding and grooming operations at a commercially zoned property at 7181 Colleyville Blvd.

A proposed All American Pet Resorts on Colleyville Boulevard dominated the Nov. 4 Colleyville City Council meeting, drawing hours of debate from residents, competing business owners, attorneys and council members. Central to the evening was a special use permit request by All American Pet Resorts to allow dog daycare, boarding and grooming operations at a commercially zoned property at 7181 Colleyville Blvd. Debate and discussion related to the pet resort consumed 2 hours, 51 minutes of the meeting , which ran 4 hours, 14 minutes.
